description: Metamodel facts per revision (namespaces, idShort pattern, enums, relaxed cardinalities), canonical IDTA template semanticIds and cardinality changes, and the EU 2023/1542 battery-passport scope.

items.question: What targetNamespace does the official AAS 3.2 XML schema declare, i.e. what xmlns must a 3.2 XML document carry?
items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/2 (3.1 is https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/1, 3.0 is https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/0). Validate each document against the XSD of its own namespace.

items.question: In an AAS 3.0 document (namespace https://admin-shell.io/aas/3/0), is the single-letter idShort 'X' legal? Is 'Motor-1' legal?
items.expected_answer: The 3.0 XSD idShort pattern is [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*: 'X' is legal (one letter suffices) and 'Motor-1' is not, because 3.0 allows no hyphen. 3.1 changed both (at least two characters, mid-string hyphen allowed).

items.question: Which values may AssetInformation/assetKind take in an AAS 3.1 document?
items.expected_answer: Type, Instance, Role and NotApplicable (the 3.1 XSD assetKind_t enumeration).

items.question: An exporter writing AAS 3.1 drops every RelationshipElement that has no 'first' or 'second' reference, saying such elements are invalid. Is a 3.1 RelationshipElement without first/second schema-invalid?
items.expected_answer: No. In the 3.1 XSD both first and second are minOccurs="0" (optional), so the element is valid and dropping it loses data.

citation.quote: <xs:element name="first" type="reference_t" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="1"/> <xs:element name="second" type="reference_t" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="1"/>

items.question: May an Entity in an AAS 3.1 document omit entityType?
items.expected_answer: Yes. In the 3.1 XSD the Entity entityType element is minOccurs="0", i.e. optional.

items.question: Can a Property omit valueType when its value is plain text?
items.expected_answer: No. valueType (DataTypeDefXsd) has cardinality 1 on Property, i.e. it is mandatory; set it explicitly, e.g. xs:string.

citation.quote: valueType Data type of the value attribute DataTypeDefXsd 1

items.question: What is the submodel semanticId of the IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate template version 3.0.1?

citation.document: IDTA 02006-3-0-1 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: Is YearOfConstruction mandatory in the IDTA 02006 Digital Nameplate v3.0 template?
items.expected_answer: No. Version 3.0 changed YearOfConstruction from [1] (mandatory) to [0..1], so it is optional (while OrderCodeOfManufacturer went the other way, from [0..1] to [1]).

citation.document: IDTA 02006-3-0-1 Digital Nameplate for Industrial Equipment

items.question: A detector recognises a Handover Documentation 2.0.1 submodel by checking that its semanticId equals https://admin-shell.io/idta/SubmodelTemplate/HandoverDocumentation/2/0. What semanticId does the published IDTA 02004-2-0-1 template actually give the submodel?
items.expected_answer: The ECLASS IRDI 0173-1#01-AHF578#003. The https://admin-shell.io/idta/SubmodelTemplate/HandoverDocumentation/2/0 string is the template submodel's id, not its semanticId.

citation.section: Table 2. Attributes of the Submodel instance

items.question: What submodel semanticId does the currently published IDTA 02003 Technical Data template (version 2.0.1) use?
items.expected_answer: The ECLASS IRDI 0173-1#01-AHX837#002. The https://admin-shell.io/ZVEI/TechnicalData/Submodel/1/2 IRI belongs to the older 1.2 template.

items.question: Should a CarbonFootprint submodel built on IDTA 02023 v1.0 still contain a TransportCarbonFootprint (TCF) block?
items.expected_answer: No. The IDTA 02023 v1.0 change log states 'Transport Carbon Footprint removed'; v1.0 carries ProductCarbonFootprints only (submodel semanticId https://admin-shell.io/idta/CarbonFootprint/CarbonFootprint/1/0).

citation.quote: Transport Carbon Footprint removed • Update from ECLASS 13 IRDIs to ECLASS 15

items.question: Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, which batteries must have a battery passport from 18 February 2027 — are LMT batteries (e.g. e-bike batteries) out of scope until later delegated acts?
items.expected_answer: No, LMT batteries are in scope. Article 77(1): from 18 February 2027 each LMT battery, each industrial battery with a capacity greater than 2 kWh and each electric vehicle battery placed on the market or put into service shall have a battery passport.

citation.quote: From 18 February 2027 each LMT battery, each industrial battery with a capacity greater than 2 kWh and each electric vehicle battery placed on the market or put into service shall have an electronic record

items.expected_answer: https://admin-shell.io/idta/digitalbatterypassport/nameplate/1/0/Nameplate (each battery-passport part has its own submodel semanticId).

items.question: May a SubmodelElement carry an embedded IEC 61360 data specification, or is that reserved for ConceptDescriptions?
items.expected_answer: It may. Part 1 says submodel elements may also have data specification templates, e.g. to mirror preferredName and unit when no corresponding concept description is available. The recommended home stays the ConceptDescription; on an element it is a permitted fallback, not an error.

citation.document: IDTA-01001 Part 1 Metamodel (official PDF, paged text)
citation.quote: Submodel elements may also have defined data specification templates.
